notes.title: Coolest Demo Update so far
notes.content:
[p][b]Hi![/b]  [/p][p]Your one-man army EmotionalDamage is here.  
(I have 2 cardinals tho..)[/p][p]I have prepared a [b]grandiose Demo update[/b] I’ve worked on for a month.  [/p][p]I had a critical issue for streamers playing my game exposing their connection string, so now we have a [b]LOBBY[/b]! 
You can currently only invite your Steam friends, and you can join the game only during that time for better session management and less annoying networking bugzzz.  [/p][p]Also, I didn’t have a tutorial in my game before, so now there is an [b]giant tableau with your duty instructions[/b] right in your ship! 
(Still no tutorial, but my vision is that you just need a general knowledge, and then it’s more fun to figure everything else out yourself!)  [/p][p]And at least [b]4 new monsters[/b] and an [b]eye laser rework[/b]!  [/p][p]I, together with Alejandro and Chaunceey, have already play-tested this version and I’ve written down a whole page in my notebook with the next prioritized improvements I’ll be working on from now. [/p][p]I feel the game is becoming something whole and genuinely enjoyable.  [/p][p]Meet your quota! [/p][p][i]— EmotionalDamage[/i][/p]

notes.title: Big Demo Update
notes.content:
[p]I've been working hard to eliminate all technical bugs I could and add most content I wanted.[/p][p]
Basically you can now try pre-release game content via Demo which will be available for a while.
Hope to hear your feedback on Discord.
[/p][p]
-EmotionalDamage[/p]
